description: Defines IPC message structures, classes, and templates for RPC communication in the Thunder namespace, including Frame, Input, Output, Init, and Setup classes, as well as message types AnnounceMessage and InvokeMessage.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a data frame with serialization/deserialization capabilities, friends with Input, Output, and ObjectInterface.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Encapsulates input data for RPC calls, including validation and setting of implementation, interface, and method IDs.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Encapsulates output data for RPC responses, including adding implementations and serialization.

classes.name: Init
classes.description: Represents initialization messages with different types (ACQUIRE, OFFER, REVOKE, REQUEST), including validation and setting parameters.

classes.name: Setup
classes.description: Represents setup configuration with implementation, sequence number, and category strings.

methods.name: instance_cast
methods.description: Template function to cast various incoming types to Core::instance_id, accommodating 32/64-bit systems.
